evidence.claim: Nitin Fire Protection Industries Ltd. operates a specialized system design and service center in Mumbai and offers dedicated fire extinguisher refilling services.
The company provides technical after-sales support primarily through structured Annual Maintenance Contracts (AMCs) to its client base.

After-Sales Service & Support Network.assessed_on: The company demonstrates present but basic post-installation service and refilling capabilities handled out of its primary Mumbai operations and regional dealer touchpoints, but lacks a widespread, transparently documented pan-India service center network specifically dedicated to advanced battery fire safety.
